text:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment: router-v2.3 -> staged-weighted-shift. Change window 20:30-21:30 UTC. Target cohorts: internal + 5% beta. Runbook: /ops/runbooks/router-shift. Please ack with :white_check_mark: if you have no holds.

maria.chen: Ack from infra. Confirming LB config: we pin sessions for 10m? also, EU-west warm nodes still at 100% for old router.

raj: Hold request for eu-west. Edge pool warming still at 60% after the priming job. Recommend delaying eu-west taper until warm=80%.

olivia: Agreed. We can start NA region first. Proposed weight plan: 0->5->20->50->100 with 5m probe at each step. If p95 > 250ms or error-rate > 0.5% rollback to stable.

jen: Add note: alerting thresholds -> p95 latency > 250ms for 5m OR 5xx rate > 0.5% => trigger auto-fallback. Runbook snippet:

`````
# router shift helper
rbctl shift --from=router-stable --to=router-v2.3 --region=na --steps=5,20,50,100 --probe=5m
`````

raj: Also pin model-version=3.2 for the feature flag route. If we see mismatch in embeddings endpoint, fallback route should switch to model 3.1.

deploy-bot: Starting NA ramp: 0% -> 5% now. Event: shift-start ts=1718076543. Monitor channel: #eng-sre. I'll post status updates every step.

maria.chen: :thumbsup: watching dashboards

deploy-bot: NA -> 5% complete. p95=120ms, 5xx=0.02%.

deploy-bot: NA -> 20% in 5m. p95=140ms, 5xx=0.03%.

olivia: Proceed to 50% after 5m probe

deploy-bot: NA -> 50% complete. p95=180ms, error=0.04%.

raj: eu-west still warming, delaying eu-west start by 15m

deploy-bot: NA -> 100% complete. Shift success. session-pin hold for 10m set.

jen: Can we pin session-cookie for 15m to be safe? Minor config: `cookie.max_age=900`

maria.chen: Updated cookie to 15m. Will keep an eye for tail latency.

oncall-bot: Note: deploy completed for NA. Postmortem window starts now if rollback occurs.

olivia: Will plan eu-west start in 10m. If any regressions, rollback steps are documented in runbook.

maria.chen: Thanks all. Closing channel after EU shift completes.

deploy-bot: EU shift started now -> 5% (delayed start). p95=150ms.

deploy-bot: EU -> 20% p95=220ms (close to threshold). Monitoring.

olivia: Hold at 20% for another 5m. If p95 drifts above 240ms, initiate rollback.

deploy-bot: EU holding. No rollback triggered. EU -> 50% after hold.

deploy-bot: EU -> 100% complete. All regions on router-v2.3. Release notes: "router v2.3: kernel optimizations for conns, session pin default increased, improved cold start caching".

jen: tagging release notes in docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/routers/v2.3

maria.chen: Marking as pinned version on prod routing table.

olivia: Great job. :tada:
